text:
tess b.: hi folks, first day—running into onboarding snags. Okta login works but when I try to set up Okta Verify the web flow shows 'No QR available' and the mobile app says 'No enrollment token'. Also Google Workspace says 'access denied'. i haven't seen a 1Password invite either. who should I bug?
it-support: welcome, tess! common causes: (1) your account wasn't yet added to the employee group so app assignments didn't apply, (2) Okta factor needs reset, or (3) browser cookie/popup blocker preventing the QR. quick checks: are you using tess.b@redwood.com? try incognito and sign in to https://redwood.okta.com and choose "Set up an authenticator app".
tess b.: yes using tess.b@redwood.com. tried incognito and still no QR. error on phone: `No enrollment token (E_NO_TOKEN)`.
security: tagging infra-admin — sometimes SCIM lag causes app assignment issues. also note: if you see a "create master password" screen on 1Password, don't create one; we use SSO.
it-support: infra-admin update: your user was created but missed the "employees" group due to a sync race. i've added you to the group and resent Google Workspace + 1Password invites. also reset your Okta factors; you should now see a QR. try scanning and accept the push.
tonkat: fyi if the QR still doesn't appear, check for enterprise browser extensions or strict privacy settings. i had one that blocked the popover. try a plain Chrome/Edge without extensions.
onboarding-bot: welcome tess! checklist: Okta sign-in, Okta Verify enrolled, Google access, 1Password SSO. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/internal/onboarding/okta-mfa
tess b.: new QR showed after the reset, scanned and enrolled. Google auth works now. 1Password invite arrived and i clicked "Sign in with Okta"  it used my Okta session. quick q: do i still need a 1Password master password?
it-support: for Redwood we use SSO for sign-in, so you won't set a separate master password during the SSO flow. 1Password may still prompt to create a local password if the invite wasn't SSO-bound; if you see that, tell us and we'll reissue. happy to confirm everything looks correct on our end.
tess b.: all green, thanks! joining #new-hires lunch at noon :)
